title: SEC task force responds to Ripple CLARITY Act concerns, floats new classification
summary: The SEC’s Crypto Task Force backed Ripple’s view that speculation alone should not trigger securities laws, responding to concerns over the CLARITY Act.

title: Trading 212 let UK retail trade crypto ETNs without FCA approval: FT
summary: In October 2025, the FCA stressed that companies must hold the correct permissions and comply with strict marketing and consumer protection rules before offering crypto ETNs.

title: KuCoin taps former LSEG exec Sabina Liu to lead MiCA expansion in Europe
summary: Former London Stock Exchange Group executive Sabina Liu will lead KuCoin EU’s MiCA-era expansion from Vienna, as the exchange pivots toward a compliance-first European strategy.

title: Bitcoin‘s ‘most accurate’ bullish signal hints at BTC price reversal
summary: Traders spotted multiple signals that suggest Bitcoin could be gearing up for another bull run, but onchain data still highlights weakness in the market.

title: South Korea’s central bank flags FX risks as lawmakers debate stablecoin issuance
summary: South Korea’s stablecoin debate remains stalled as the central bank raises concerns over capital flows, issuer oversight and US dollar-linked risks.

title: ASIC wins $9.3M penalty against BPS Financial over misleading Qoin Wallet
summary: Australia's Federal Court ordered BPS Financial to pay $1.3 million for unlicensed conduct and $8 million for misleading and deceptive representations.

title: 60% of top US banks are geared up for Bitcoin: River
summary: Brian Armstrong, the CEO of crypto exchange Coinbase, said a takeaway from his time at the Davos forum was that most of the bank CEOs he met were pro-crypto.

title: Senator Marshall to shelve card fees provision in crypto bill markup: Report
summary: US Senator Roger Marshall filed an amendment last week that would have forced companies to compete on swipe fees.

title: Hyperliquid HIP-3 open-interest hits $793M on commodities surge
summary: Hyperliquid's HIP-3, also known as "Builder Deployed Perpetuals," lets anyone who stakes 500,000 HYPE to create a new perpetual futures market on the Hyperliquid blockchain.

title: Viral AI assistant ‘Clawdbot’ risks leaking private messages, credentials
summary: Misconfigured Clawdbot servers exposed API keys, private chats and credentials, cybersecurity researchers warn after the AI assistant surged in popularity
